message.content: In Christian theology, the focus is on the life, teachings, death, and resurrection of Jesus Christ, who is regarded as the central figure of the faith. However, many Christians also hold the Old Testament prophets—such as Moses, Isaiah, Jeremiah, and others—in high regard for their role in revealing God’s will and preparing the way for Jesus. The importance placed on any particular prophet can vary among denominations, traditions, and individual believers.
